description: Run the rule-based QA checks on a branch now and return the result: counts per severity (error / warning / info) and the issues, each with key, language, check, code and params. Checks: placeholders, ICU syntax and plural categories, HTML tags, length vs charLimit, whitespace, untranslated, glossary, numbers and punctuation. It changes no translation. Use it after translating: fix every error (rewrite the value or fix its placeholders), run it again, then call check_merge_gate before merging. Pass `keys` to re-check only some keys. Checks the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

name: run_qa
title: Run QA Checks
